formulas.formula: Work item age = today's date - start date + 1
formulas.inputs: today 25 Nov 2026; starts 24,17,23,19,12,20,16,18 Nov and 9 Nov

formulas.formula: Nearest-rank percentile = value at rank ceil(p/100 x n) of sorted cycle times
formulas.variables: p percentile; n = 30 finished items; cycle time in calendar days

formulas.formula: Conditional share meeting SLE = count(age <= CT <= 14) / count(CT >= age)
formulas.variables: CT historical cycle time (days); age current work item age (days)

formulas.formula: Little's Law: average cycle time ~ average WIP / average throughput
formulas.variables: WIP in items; throughput in items per calendar day; cycle time in days
formulas.inputs: 30 items in 42 days (0.714/day, 5/week); mean CT 275/30 = 9.17 days; current WIP 9
formulas.result: implied past average WIP 6.55 (~6.5); projected average CT 9/0.714 = 12.6 days

formulas.formula: Per-stage pace: 85th percentile (nearest rank) of age at which past items left each stage
formulas.variables: stage exit ages in days for the same 30 illustrative items (synthetic, derived as round(fraction x cycle time) with fractions 0.2/0.6/0.8/1.0)
template Cards tab: D Column, E Started, F Finished, G Cycle time; added I Age, J Stage number, K Plot X
formulas.inputs: test rows on a copy of kanban-board-template-advanced.xlsx

formula_verification_script:
import math, statistics as st, datetime as dt
ct=[2,3,3,4,4,5,5,5,6,6,6,7,7,7,8,8,8,9,9,10,10,11,12,12,13,14,16,18,21,26]  # cycle times, calendar days, finish-start+1
n=len(ct); s=sorted(ct)
def nr(data,p):
    d=sorted(data); r=math.ceil(p/100*len(d)); return r,d[r-1]
print("n",n,"sum",sum(ct),"mean",round(st.mean(ct),2),"median(avg)",st.median(ct))
for p in (50,70,85,95): print("P",p,nr(ct,p))
print("share<=14",sum(c<=14 for c in ct),"/",n, sum(c<=14 for c in ct)/n)
today=dt.date(2026,11,25)
wip=[("A","Analysis",dt.date(2026,11,24)),("B","Analysis",dt.date(2026,11,17)),("C","Development",dt.date(2026,11,23)),
     ("D","Development",dt.date(2026,11,19)),("E","Development",dt.date(2026,11,12)),("F","Review",dt.date(2026,11,20)),
     ("G","Review",dt.date(2026,11,16)),("H","Testing",dt.date(2026,11,18)),("I","Testing",dt.date(2026,11,9))]
ages={}
for k,stg,d in wip:
    a=(today-d).days+1; ages[k]=a
    ge=[c for c in ct if c>=a]; ok=[c for c in ge if c<=14]
    rank=sum(c<a for c in ct)/n  # share of past items that finished faster than current age
    print(k,stg,d.strftime('%a %d %b'),"age",a,"| past items finished in fewer days:",f"{rank:.0%}","| P(<=14 | >=age)=",f"{len(ok)}/{len(ge)}", (f"{len(ok)/len(ge):.0%}" if ge else "-"))
print("total WIP age",sum(ages.values()),"avg age",round(sum(ages.values())/len(ages),2),"WIP",len(ages))
ge=[c for c in ct if c>=17]; print("I: P(<=21|>=17)",sum(c<=21 for c in ge),"/",len(ge))
# per-stage exit ages (synthetic, derived from each item's cycle time)
fr={"Analysis":0.2,"Development":0.6,"Review":0.8,"Testing":1.0}
exits={k:[max(1,round(f*c)) for c in ct] for k,f in fr.items()}
for k,v in exits.items(): print("exit age",k,"P50",nr(v,50)[1],"P85",nr(v,85)[1])
# Little's law check: 30 items finished over 6 weeks (42 days)
th=30/42; print("throughput/day",round(th,3),"per week",round(th*7,2))
print("LL avg CT at WIP 9:",round(9/th,2),"days; implied avg WIP for mean CT",round(st.mean(ct)*th,2))
